risk_if_not_implemented: Without Endpoint Protection Mechanisms, Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) may operate with insecure, unauthorized or drifted configurations that expand the attack surface. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Modification / Loss of System Integrity (R-AM-2), System / Data Compromise (Technical Vector) (R-BC-4), System / Service Compromise (R-EX-7), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), Loss of Data Integrity (R-IP-3), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Secure Baseline Configurations
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to develop, document and maintain secure baseline configurations for Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) that are consistent with industry-accepted hardening standards.
compensating_control_1.justification: Secure Baseline Configurations (CFG-04) provides configuration hardening that compensates for the absence of Endpoint Protection Measures (END-03) by eliminating unnecessary services and enforcing secure settings to reduce inherent exposure. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Vulnerability & Patch Management Program (VPMP)
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation and monitoring of risk-based vulnerability management capabilities.
compensating_control_2.justification: Vulnerability & Patch Management Program (VPMP) (VPM-02) provides policy-level governance that compensates for the absence of Endpoint Protection Measures (END-03) by establishing documented expectations, accountability structures, and organizational guardrails. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
